Specification: This specification models a modified two-phase commit protocol with a transaction manager, multiple resource managers, and a backup transaction manager that can take over if the primary transaction manager becomes hidden after deciding. The resource managers move among working, prepared, committed, aborted, and failed states; the transaction manager decides commit or abort based on global conditions, and optional failures are controlled by the constants RMMAYFAIL and TMMAYFAIL. The spec defines the initial state, the next-state relation, weak fairness for all processes, an eventual termination property, and invariants for type correctness, consistency of decisions, and absence of committed resource managers in NotCommitted.
IfThenElse: IF rmState[self] \in {"working", "prepared"} THEN /\ \/ /\ rmState[self] = "working" /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![self] = "prepared"] \/ /\ \/ /\ tmState = "commit" /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![self] = "committed"] \/ /\ rmState[self] = "working" \/ tmState = "abort" /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![self] = "aborted"] \/ /\ IF RMMAYFAIL /\ ~\E rm \in RM: rmState[rm] = "failed" THEN /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![self] = "failed"] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED rmState /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "RS"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"] /\ UNCHANGED rmState
IF RMMAYFAIL /\ ~\E rm \in RM: rmState[rm] = "failed" THEN /\ rmState' = [rmState EXCEPT ![self] = "failed"] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED rmState
IF TMMAYFAIL THEN /\ tmState' = "hidden" ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED tmState
IF TMMAYFAIL THEN /\ tmState' = "hidden" ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED tmState
